nameJa: Top chatのクローズアップ
headline:
Fullscreen
Live Chat
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Generate ONE premium Chrome extension discovery promo tile, exact landscape 11:7 rectangle, 1760x1120 target, NOT panoramic. Concept 05: PRODUCT CLOSE-UP, unmistakably authentic YouTube Live Chat.

The two provided images are STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for real YouTube chat anatomy. Never reproduce actual creator, game, real people, names, handles, messages, or screenshot. Entire scene must be original artwork styled as a crisp product promotional illustration.

Design: editorial split. Left 56% has charcoal near-black backdrop with huge clean condensed sans-serif type, top/left aligned, white word on line 1 and vivid red words on line 2:
"Fullscreen"
"Live Chat"
Spell these EXACTLY. Both words/phrase must be large and readable at 440x280. Beneath the type, a restrained one-line gray sentence "Big stream. Same chat."
At bottom-left, a section of original game video shows a tiny explorer on a warm orange sunset canyon with stylized blue waterfalls. It is a flat video rectangle, no physical display or gamer room, extending behind the chat as a fullscreen surface.
The right roughly 42% is a very large near-black #161616 native YouTube live-chat pane, flat, almost-square corners, sitting INSIDE the video surface. Chat itself is the hero. Minimal depth, NO neon border, NO glass bubble messenger.
The chat pane's header must read "Top chat" with small down-chevron and vertical ⋮ on the right. Thin divider below.
7 clearly typeset compact native message rows. Small round avatar at row start; MUTED GRAY @handle followed by WHITE message on SAME SINGLE horizontal line. No label above separate bubble, no placeholder gray horizontal bars. Exact fictional rows:
"@alex GG"
"@mira that was close"
"@sam let's go!"
"@luna clutch!"
"@kai nice run"
"@jules one more"
"@rin great stream"
These are ordinary original fictional viewers, no sponsor badges, donation cards or official usernames.
Large obvious native composer at bottom: small own avatar, placeholder "Chat..." sitting on thin gray underline, smiley outline and outlined paper-plane/send triangle aligned right. The composer looks usable but no message has been sent. Natural YouTube UI density, readable yet compact with equal row spacing. Dark scene, white crisp typography with limited red accents. Finish like a sophisticated browser extension product poster. No YouTube or Chrome logos. No official endorsement, rating, verification, corner numbers, watermarks or mockup labels. Exactly one chat pane. Leave content safely inside edges.
conceptNote: Large native YouTube-style Top chat hero over an original sunset canyon game, with clear white/red typography.
uiTreatment: Flat near-black large panel; circular avatars, muted inline handles and white comments; native composer and outlined send.
